props.template: A ski resort sells 680 passes at a base price of $120. Each price increase is $5, and 20 fewer passes are sold for each increase. Let x be the number of price increases. Worked solution: p(x) = 120 + 5x; s(x) = 680 - 20x; P(x) = (120 + 5x)(680 - 20x) = 120(680) - 120(20x) + 5x(680) - 5x(20x) = -100x^2 + 1000x + 81600. Check the key values: base price {{blank:priceBase}}, price increase {{blank:priceStep}}, base sales {{blank:salesBase}}, sales loss {{blank:salesLoss}}, a {{blank:coefficientA}}, b {{blank:coefficientB}}, and c {{blank:coefficientC}}.

A ski resort sells 270 passes at a base price of $230. Each price increase is $10, and 10 fewer passes are sold for each increase. Let x be the number of price increases.
